0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3, 3rd in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back, on a one-game winning streak) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3, 4th in the Northwest and 2 games back, on a one-game losing streak) in this eighth game of the Raptors' season. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto, while Denver is without DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Toronto lost both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
